title: System Monitor
description: What uses your head unit's memory and processor, like a computer's activity monitor: memory in use, every app and program with its own memory and how much it grew in the last 3 minutes (leaks stand out), processor use per core, load, temperature and clock. Tap a heading to sort, a row for its details. Read-only, only while it is on screen; no car signals, no internet. iDrive 8. Original app by hexlay - ID8 Variant by IterioDev.
